comment: One-click starters for the asks that recur. {entity} and {period} are filled from --entity / --period (CLI) or typed over in the dashboard. Each runs the same lane as a typed request.

templates.label: Flux, last two months
templates.title: Flux for {entity}, last two months
templates.body: Create a flux for {entity} for the last two months and produce the report as an xlsx, with a short memo naming the five biggest movements and the driver of each.

templates.label: AR over 60 days
templates.title: AR over 60 days for {entity}
templates.body: Pull AR over 60 days as of {period} for {entity} into a workbook: one row per customer with invoice numbers and due dates, and a totals row.

templates.label: Did an integration migrate?
templates.title: Did all {integration} transactions migrate for {entity}
templates.body: Did all of the {integration} transactions for {entity} migrate into Dime since {period}? Show me what is missing, with ids and amounts, and the last sync date.

templates.label: Payroll register vs GL
templates.title: Payroll tie-out for {entity}, {period}
templates.body: Compare {period} payroll in the GL for {entity} to the attached payroll register and explain every difference.

templates.label: Vendors from W-9s
templates.title: Set up vendors from W-9s for {entity}
templates.body: For {entity}: here are vendor W-9s. Set the vendors up in Dime (propose them for my approval; do not duplicate any vendor that already exists) and list what you could not map.

templates.label: Reclass transactions
templates.title: Reclass for {entity}, {period}
templates.body:
For {entity} in {period}: reclass the transactions described below to the right account. Show me the balanced entry or the categorisation change for each before anything is posted.

Transactions:
-
